integrity: The proof is analytic; an independently coded stdlib transition-matrix checker tests 126 finite parameter combinations, which cannot certify the asymptotic statement. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-target discrete-time resetting on loopless unweighted complete graphs only; observed vertex-sequence entropy, not reset-flag entropy; finite-size uniqueness of optimal reset rates and transfer to other graph families unproved. Historical priority not independently established.
title: Lambert-\(W\) entropy-optimal resetting on complete graphs
